_derivation.note: official_fields.json is produced by build_official_fields.py (committed alongside, deterministic). The hubspot module extracts daily CRM aggregates from the CRM v3 Search API on two objects (POST /crm/v3/objects/contacts/search and .../deals/search), counting paginated results client-side (HubSpot exposes NO native daily aggregate). The catalog curates: (1) the DEFAULT properties of the four main CRM objects the Search/Properties API exposes -- contacts, companies, deals, tickets; (2) the module-derived daily metrics the connector computes (new_contacts, deals_created, deals_closed, deal_amount) + the canonical `date` dimension.
_derivation.namespacing_rule: A HubSpot property internal name (createdate, hubspot_owner_id, hs_object_id, city, ...) legitimately exists on several objects. The merge engine keys the catalog by a GLOBALLY UNIQUE field_id (duplicates are dropped + reported), so each object's property is emitted as `<object>_<property>` (e.g. contact_createdate, deal_createdate) while `source_field` preserves the raw provider token (createdate). The 5 module-derived fields keep their bare ids with the exact source_field the manifest declares; a namespaced property that would collapse onto a derived id (deal `amount` -> deal_amount) is not re-emitted (the derived field owns that family).
_derivation.count_divergence: This is intentionally the DEFAULT-property surface of the four main CRM objects (88 fields: 23 metrics / 65 dimensions), NOT the full HubSpot property universe. Supermetrics publishes 174 metrics / 403 dimensions across 45 sections (ANALYTICS|COMPANY|CONTACT|DEAL|EMAIL|EMAIL CAMPAIGN|ENGAGEMENT (CALL/EMAIL/MEETING/NOTE/TASK)|FORM|TICKET|WORKFLOW|...). The large gap is EXPECTED and honest: (a) Supermetrics spans every Hub -- Marketing Email, Email Campaign, Forms, Workflows, per-Engagement-type (Call/Email/Meeting/Note/Task) -- surfaces this module's connector.py does NOT query; (b) Supermetrics counts every account-defined CUSTOM property and every bucketed/derived column as its own field; (c) Supermetrics itemises breakdown-value permutations as distinct dimensions. Those extra fields are enrichment SUSPECTS (reported in the fusion report's enrichment_only_ids), NEVER emitted, because emitting fields the module cannot pull would be dishonest drift, not coverage.

sources._fetch: curl -sL https://docs.supermetrics.com/docs/hubspot-fields.md -o server/modules/hubspot/catalog_sources/supermetrics.md   # DO NOT COMMIT this file (enrichment snapshot only)

probe.structural_note: HubSpot CRM search POSTs a properties[] list on the selected portal over a bounded window (limit=1). The probe batches up to 20 properties per search; a property HubSpot does not recognise is recorded unsupported (400 PROPERTY_DOESNT_EXIST) after the batch is bisected to isolate it.

excluded_sections.COMPANY: The daily pull makes no companies endpoint calls; requires additional fetches.
excluded_sections.TICKET: The daily pull makes no tickets endpoint calls; requires additional fetches.
excluded_sections.ANALYTICS: Analytics API surfaces are not called by the daily pull.
